findings.title: Keyboard focus drops to <body> when an order item reaches the first or last position
findings.evidence: Script output: 'after middle move (index2->1): focus = BUTTON:Move up: Safranin counterstain' then 'after reaching top (index1->0): focus = BODY:' and 'after move down index3->4 (last): focus = BODY:'. The pressed button gets disabled (engines.tsx:130-131 disabled={disabled || index === 0} / index === order.length-1) and the browser drops focus. Screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-B/shots/r9b01-order-focus-lost.png. Full keyboard run (p14.mjs) also logged ISSUES ['order: focus lost after Move up'].
findings.repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-B/r9b01-order-focus.mjs (run with STACK=2 against my second stack API 4203 / web 4204; helpers lib.mjs, ui.mjs, kb.mjs in the same dir). Steps: open Microbiology > Gram Stain Challenge, Tab to 'Move up: <item at position 2>', press Enter: item moves to the top and document.activeElement is BODY; next Tab starts again at the skip link / Exit mission.
findings.expected: After a move the keyboard focus stays on a control of the moved row (for example the Move button that is still enabled, or the row's other button) so a user can keep reordering without re-tabbing from the top of the page.

findings.fix_hint: web/src/components/engines.tsx:111-134 (DragOrder): keep a ref per row and after setAnswer move focus to the same-direction button if enabled else the opposite one (useLayoutEffect on order), or use aria-disabled instead of disabled for the boundary buttons.

findings.area: Boot (guest session), mission answer, hint, start (web/src/lib/api.ts)
findings.title: No client-side request timeout: a stalled request leaves the UI loading or 'Checking...' forever with no alert, no Retry and the controls disabled
findings.evidence: r9b-hang.mjs: with POST /auth/demo never answered, 30 s later h1 = 'Preparing your investigation...', buttons [], alerts 0 (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-B/shots/hang-boot-m.png). With POST /attempts/*/answer never answered, 30 s later Submit label 'Checking...', all three answer options disabled, hint disabled, alerts 0, role=status empty (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-B/shots/hang-answer-m.png). api() in web/src/lib/api.ts has no AbortController/timeout.
findings.repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r9-B/r9b-hang.mjs (run with STACK=2 against my second stack API 4203 / web 4204; helpers lib.mjs, ui.mjs, kb.mjs in the same dir).
findings.expected: After a bounded wait (for example 15-20 s) the request is aborted, a role=alert explains the server did not answer, and Retry (boot) or Submit/Hint (mission) become usable again.
findings.actual: Indefinite spinner/'Checking...'; the learner can only reload or press Exit. Because the answer might have been recorded, the mission code's resync logic (handleFailure) is never reached either.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/api.ts:51-58 api(): wrap fetch in an AbortController with a timeout (e.g. 20 s) that throws ApiError(0,'timeout',...). mission.tsx handleFailure already resyncs on status 0.
